site.name: Accidental Mine
overview: Accidental Mine is a documented historic gold-silver mine in Clear Creek County, preserved as a named mine feature on Idaho Springs-area topographic mapping.
moreHistory: USGS-derived mapping places Accidental Mine near 39.729988, -105.551943 at about 8,199 feet elevation. The mapped mine locality supports identification of the historic property; no surviving portal, shaft, structures, or present-day access condition are asserted.

sourceReferences.title: USGS-derived Accidental Mine topographic feature record
